subject: Pocket Cucco
text: To make the Pocket Cucco happy, Link must have it wake up someone lazy, like Talon.

evidence.quote:
In order to make the Cucco happy, have it wake up someone lazy,
 like Talon.

subject: Cojiro
text: Returning the Pocket Cucco to the Cucco lady once it is happy rewards Link with Cojiro.

evidence.quote:
You'll get this for returning the Pocket Cucco when
 it's happy to the Cucco lady.

subject: Odd Mushroom
text: Giving Cojiro to its owner in the Lost Woods rewards Link with the Odd Mushroom.

evidence.quote:
This is given to you
 when you give Cojiro to its owner in the Lost Woods.

subject: Odd Potion
text: The Odd Potion is brewed from the Odd Mushroom at Kakariko Village's Old Witch's Potion Shop.

evidence.quote:
This is an odd potion made from the mushroom you brought to
 Kakariko Village's Old Witch's Potion Shop.

subject: Poacher's Saw
text: The young girl in the Lost Woods gives Link the Poacher's Saw in exchange for the Odd Potion.

evidence.quote:
This is the saw the punk guy left behind in Lost Woods. The young
 girl who saw it will give this to you in return for the Odd Potion.

subject: Broken Goron's Sword
text: The man in Gerudo Valley gives Link the Broken Goron's Sword in exchange for the Poacher's Saw.

evidence.quote:
The guy in Gerudo Valley
 gives you this in exchange for his Poacher's Saw.

subject: Prescription
text: Biggoron on top of Death Mountain needs eye drops for his eye irritation before mending the sword, providing a Prescription to take to King Zora.

evidence.quote:
The Biggoron on top of Death
 Mountain needs some eye drops for his eye irritation before he can mend the
 Broken Goron's Sword. Take this to King Zora.

subject: Eyeball Frog
text: King Zora provides the Eyeball Frog, a fresh ingredient that will spoil quickly and must be delivered to the old man in Lake Hylia's Laboratory.

evidence.quote:
This fresh ingredient for the eye drops will spoil quickly! King
 Zora gives you this. Bring it to the old man in Lake Hylia's Laboratory.

subject: World's Greatest Eye Drops
text: The World's Greatest Eye Drops go bad very quickly and must be rushed to Biggoron on top of Death Mountain.

evidence.quote:
This item will go bad very soon! Take it to the Biggoron on the
 top of Death Mountain quickly!

subject: Claim Check
text: Presenting the Claim Check to Biggoron on top of Death Mountain after three days yields the Biggoron's Sword.

evidence.quote:
Show the Biggoron on the top of Death Mountain this after three
 days and you'll get the Biggoron's Sword!

subject: Rupees
text: Rupee values correspond to color: Green Rupees are worth 1, Blue are 5, Red are 20, Purple are 50, and Huge yellow ones are 200.

evidence.quote:
Green Rupees are worth 1; Blue are 5; Red are 20; 
 Purple are 50; and Huge (yellow) ones are 200

subject: Dungeon Map
text: The Dungeon Map reveals all rooms and floors on the Map Screen, highlighting previously visited rooms in blue.

evidence.quote:
This reveals all the floors and rooms of a dungeon in the Map
 Screen. Blue rooms are ones you've visited before.

subject: Compass
text: The Compass reveals treasure chest locations, marks the player's exact location on the Map Screen, and indicates room entrances with a red mark on the mini map.

evidence.quote:
This, along with the Dungeon Map, reveals treasure chest
 locations, and also shows your exact location in a room when viewed from the 
 Map Screen. In the mini map, it also shows a red mark, which shows where you 
 entered the room from.

subject: Boss Key
text: A Boss Key unlocks the large door that leads to the boss of a temple.

evidence.quote:
A large key which unlocks a large door leading to the boss of a
 temple.

subject: Big Poe
text: Capturing all 10 Big Poes in Hyrule Field and turning them into the Ghost Shop yields an Empty Bottle.

evidence.quote:
If you
 capture all 10 Big Poes in Hyrule Field and give them to the Ghost Shop, 
 you'll get an Empty Bottle!

subject: Big Poe
text: Big Poes are easier to catch while riding horseback and sniping them with arrows.

evidence.quote:
It's
 easier to catch them if you're on horseback and snipe them with arrows.

subject: Blue Fire
text: Blue Fire can be captured in a bottle to melt red ice, and is typically found in Ice Cavern or purchased in certain shops.

evidence.quote:
This nice, refreshing 
 fire can melt away red ice. Usually found in Ice Cavern, but can also be sold
 in certain stores.

subject: Blue Potion
text: Blue Potion fully restores health damage as well as magic, and is sold by the hag in Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote:
It not only heals any damage, but also 
 refills magic! This is a rare potion and seems to only be sold by the hag in
 Kakariko Village.

subject: Bug
text: Bottled bugs unearth certain Gold Skulltulas or distract enemies, and are commonly found under bushes and small rocks.

evidence.quote:
No real use for them other than to
 unearth certain Gold Skulltulas. They can also be used to distract enemies.
 Bugs are usually found under bushes and small rocks.

subject: Fairy
text: A bottled Fairy can be used anytime to restore health, and will automatically revive Link if he dies.

evidence.quote:
You can use this Fairy at any time to restore
 health, just like Red Potion. However, if you have one of these, and you die,
 you'll be revived!

subject: Fish
text: Bottled fish is used to open the entrance to the Jabu-Jabu's Belly dungeon for Young Link.

evidence.quote:
There's really only one use for bottled fish, and that's to open up
 the Jabu-Jabu's Belly dungeon for Young Link.

subject: Letter
text: Princess Ruto's letter to King Zora comes inside the third obtainable bottle and must be delivered to King Zora.

evidence.quote:
A letter from Princess Ruto to her dad, the King Zora. This letter
 already comes inside the third bottle you collect. Bring this classic letter 
 in a bottle to King Zora.

subject: Lon Lon Milk
text: Lon Lon Milk is nutritious milk that restores health and provides two helpings.

evidence.quote: Nutritious milk that restores health. Contains two helpings!

subject: Poe
text: Bottled Poe souls damage health if consumed, but can be sold to someone obsessed with Poes.

evidence.quote:
The soul of a defeated Poe. Don't drink it, it's harmful to your
 health. Instead, sell the soul to someone who's crazy about Poes...

subject: Magic Beans
text: A merchant in Zora's River sells Magic Beans to child Link at an increasing price for each bean purchased.

evidence.quote:
There's a single character over in Zora's River while Link's a child who sells 
Magic Beans....at a considerably higher price with each one.

subject: Magic Beans
text: Magic Beans must be planted in soft soil plots as Young Link, and only grow fully once Link becomes Adult Link.

evidence.quote:
The beans don't grow fully 
until you're Adult Link, so make sure you plant any Magic Beans you have as 
Young Link (that's the only way you can do it, anyway).

subject: Magic Bean Plot #1
text: Magic Bean Plot #1 is located right next to the Magic Bean seller in Zora's River.

evidence.quote:
Magic Bean Plot #1:
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
Location: This one is right by the person who sells Young Link Magic Beans in
 Zora's River.
